package main

// Generates the legacy on-wire fixture by running the UNMODIFIED code from
// b5a986a under a recording MQTT client.
//
//	go test -run TestGenerateLegacyFixture -v
//
// Writes legacy-fixture.json. The media-control variant is selected by the
// MAC2MQTT_FIXTURE_VARIANT env var ("with-media-control" or "no-media-control");
// main probes for it with exec.LookPath, so the caller controls that by running
// this with media-control hidden from PATH. Nothing in main is modified.

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"testing"
	"time"

	mqtt "github.com/eclipse/paho.mqtt.golang"
)

type capOp struct {
	Kind     string `json:"kind"`
	Topic    string `json:"topic"`
	QoS      byte   `json:"qos"`
	Retained bool   `json:"retained"`
	Payload  string `json:"payload,omitempty"`
}

type capToken struct{}

func (capToken) Wait() bool                     { return true }
func (capToken) WaitTimeout(time.Duration) bool { return true }
func (capToken) Done() <-chan struct{}          { ch := make(chan struct{}); close(ch); return ch }
func (capToken) Error() error                   { return nil }

type capClient struct{ ops []capOp }

func (c *capClient) IsConnected() bool      { return true }
func (c *capClient) IsConnectionOpen() bool { return true }
func (c *capClient) Connect() mqtt.Token    { return capToken{} }
func (c *capClient) Disconnect(uint)        {}
func (c *capClient) Publish(topic string, qos byte, retained bool, payload interface{}) mqtt.Token {
	var b []byte
	switch v := payload.(type) {
	case []byte:
		b = v
	case string:
		b = []byte(v)
	}
	c.ops = append(c.ops, capOp{"publish", topic, qos, retained, string(b)})
	return capToken{}
}
func (c *capClient) Subscribe(topic string, qos byte, _ mqtt.MessageHandler) mqtt.Token {
	c.ops = append(c.ops, capOp{Kind: "subscribe", Topic: topic, QoS: qos})
	return capToken{}
}
func (c *capClient) SubscribeMultiple(map[string]byte, mqtt.MessageHandler) mqtt.Token {
	return capToken{}
}
func (c *capClient) Unsubscribe(...string) mqtt.Token        { return capToken{} }
func (c *capClient) AddRoute(string, mqtt.MessageHandler)    {}
func (c *capClient) OptionsReader() mqtt.ClientOptionsReader { return mqtt.ClientOptionsReader{} }

const discoveryDest = "homeassistant/device/test-host/config"

// normaliseDiscovery replaces the only fields that legitimately vary per host
// with fixed placeholders, so the rest of the payload can be compared exactly.
// Everything else (component keys, state_topic, value_template, units,
// device_class, payload mappings, discovery-level qos, availability wiring) is
// preserved verbatim.
func normaliseDiscovery(t *testing.T, raw string) string {
	t.Helper()
	var doc map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(raw), &doc); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("discovery payload is not JSON: %v", err)
	}
	if dev, ok := doc["dev"].(map[string]interface{}); ok {
		if _, present := dev["ids"]; present {
			dev["ids"] = "<SERIAL>" // getSerialnumber()
		}
		if _, present := dev["mdl"]; present {
			dev["mdl"] = "<MODEL>" // getModel()
		}
	}
	// Marshal through the map so key order is canonical (encoding/json sorts
	// map keys), making the result stable and diffable.
	out, err := json.MarshalIndent(doc, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(out)
}

type fixture struct {
	Source                string  `json:"source_commit"`
	Variant               string  `json:"variant"`
	MediaControlAvailable bool    `json:"media_control_available"`
	ConnectOps            []capOp `json:"connect_ops"`
	DiscoveryPayload      string  `json:"discovery_payload"`
	PeriodicOps           []capOp `json:"periodic_ops"`
	Will                  capOp   `json:"will"`
}

func TestGenerateLegacyFixture(t *testing.T) {
	variant := os.Getenv("MAC2MQTT_FIXTURE_VARIANT")
	if variant == "" {
		t.Fatal("set MAC2MQTT_FIXTURE_VARIANT")
	}
	available := isMediaControlAvailable()
	switch variant {
	case "with-media-control":
		if !available {
			t.Fatal("variant expects media-control on PATH, but it is absent")
		}
	case "no-media-control":
		if available {
			t.Fatal("variant expects media-control hidden from PATH, but it was found")
		}
	default:
		t.Fatalf("unknown variant %q", variant)
	}

	app := &Application{
		config: &config{
			IP: "192.168.10.1", Port: "1883",
			Hostname: "test-host", Topic: "mac2mqtt",
			DiscoveryPrefix: "homeassistant",
		},
		hostname: "test-host",
		topic:    "mac2mqtt/test-host",
	}
	// Neutralise the background workers with their own production CAS guards.
	app.activityMonitorStarted.Store(true)
	app.mediaStreamStarted.Store(true)

	c := &capClient{}
	app.connectHandler(c)

	var discovery string
	for _, o := range c.ops {
		if o.Topic == discoveryDest {
			discovery = normaliseDiscovery(t, o.Payload)
		}
	}
	if discovery == "" {
		t.Fatal("no discovery payload captured")
	}

	// The periodic tick body, as main wrote it inline in the select loop.
	pc := &capClient{}
	app.updateVolume(pc)
	app.updateMute(pc)
	app.updateMediaDevices(pc)
	pc.Publish(app.getTopicPrefix()+"/status/alive", 0, true, "online")

	// Keep payloads only where they are config-derived and stable. Live system
	// readings (volume, mute, caffeinate, now playing) are excluded; the
	// discovery payload is captured separately and in full, above.
	stable := func(ops []capOp) []capOp {
		out := make([]capOp, 0, len(ops))
		for _, o := range ops {
			if o.Topic != "mac2mqtt/test-host/status/alive" {
				o.Payload = ""
			}
			out = append(out, o)
		}
		return out
	}

	f := fixture{
		Source:                "b5a986ad2b5cc76a6010ce455baa254b554a905d",
		Variant:               variant,
		MediaControlAvailable: available,
		ConnectOps:            stable(c.ops),
		DiscoveryPayload:      discovery,
		PeriodicOps:           stable(pc.ops),
		Will:                  capOp{"will", app.getTopicPrefix() + "/status/alive", 0, true, "offline"},
	}

	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(f, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	name := "legacy-onwire-b5a986a-" + variant + ".json"
	if err := os.WriteFile(name, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var keys []string
	var doc struct {
		Cmps map[string]json.RawMessage `json:"cmps"`
	}
	json.Unmarshal([]byte(discovery), &doc)
	for k := range doc.Cmps {
		keys = append(keys, k)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	t.Logf("wrote %s: %d connect ops, %d periodic ops, %d components, payload %d bytes",
		name, len(f.ConnectOps), len(f.PeriodicOps), len(keys), len(discovery))
}
